sn45.141:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave kūṭāgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo || sabbā tā kūṭaṅgamā kūṭaninnā kūṭasamosaraṇā || kūṭaṃ tāsam aggam akkhāyati ||
sn45.142:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci mūlagandhā || kāḷānusāriyaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati ||
sn45.143:3.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci sāragandhā || lohitacandanaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati ||
sn45.144:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci pupphagandhā || vassikaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati ||
sn45.145:5.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci kuṭṭarājāno sabbe te rañño cakkavattissa anuyantā bhavanti tesaṃ rājā cakkavatti aggam akkhāyati ||
